content: आपत् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To fall upon, attack, assail; उदायुधानापततः <ls>R. 12. 44</ls>, <ls n="R.">5. 50</ls>; <ls>Bk. 3. 48</ls>. .²2 To approach, come towards <ls>K. 202</ls>; एतत् प्रायेण श्रुतिविषयमापतितमेव <ls>K. 136</ls> has reached the ears; <ls n="K.">268</ls>. .²3 To fly towards, come in flying, come or drive in haste, rush upon; अपि नाध्वश्रमः शीघ्रं रथेनापततस्तव <ls>Rām. 2. 72. 5</ls> .²4 .³({%a%}) To happen, take place, occur, come to pass; कथमिदमापतितम् <ls>U. 2</ls>; <ls>K. 262</ls>, <ls n="K.">158</ls>; अहो न शोभनमापतितम् <ls>Pt. 2</ls>. .³({%b%}) To fall to oneʼs lot or share, befall; अहोऽस्माकं महद्भोजनमापतितम् <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; आपतन्ति हि संसारपथमवतणिनामेते वृत्तान्ताः <ls>K. 175</ls>, <ls n="K.">132</ls>; सर्वस्यैव स्खलितमापतति <ls n="K.">291</ls>; <ls>H. 1. 28</ls>, <ls n="H. 1.">168</ls>. .²5 .³({%a%}) To occur to, cross (the mind); इति हृदये नापतितम् <ls>K. 288</ls> .³({%b%}) To be felt or regarded; मधुरतराण्यापतन्ति मनसः <ls>K. 103</ls> are felt or regarded; <ls n="K.">202</ls>, <ls n="K.">236</ls>, <ls n="K.">329</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (पातयति) To go towards, approach (<ab>Ved.</ab>).
